title: Contratto e scala di astrazione ionica
mode: local evidence audit and interface specification; no training

interface.reference_precision: float64 native/reference and float32 candidate, with explicit numerical floor
interface.calcium_domain: Nonnegative cai in mM; numerical floor 1e-7 mM in existing SK formula. Task37 must freeze covered log-Ca range and stress strata before generation/training; no extrapolation claim beyond it.
interface.level1_state: 18 physical gates, ordered as channels/gate_names; no latent reduction
inputs: local calcium in mM at declared phase
declared channel parameters and presence masks
interface.parameter_policy: gbar and E remain explicit readout parameters initially; variation of kinetics/temperature is outside scope until included in the declared training contract
phases: A: update V-dependent gates from previous ionic state and current V; calcium-channel opening uses these updated gates and current V for the calcium source
B: exact unchanged CaDynamics consumes that source and computes next cai
C: SK update consumes next cai and previous SK state, in the same tick; other gate states are not advanced a second time
D: final channel conductances and solver coefficients are formed; membrane solver consumes them with its existing synaptic phase
outputs: next 18 gates at level1, later next latent state
11 ionic current densities in mA/cm2 at declared voltage and phase
interface.readout: a_k=product of specified gate powers at level1; later learned effective openings. g_k=gbar_k*a_k; I_k=g_k*(V-E_k). Keep algebra cheap and exact unless a preregistered ablation demonstrates utility of learning it.
interface.sign_convention: Outward positive current; inward negative current when V<E and conductance positive.
interface.initialization: Level1 uses explicit physical initial state. Future latent encoder may consume physical initial state once if available; warmup and standard-state initialization are separate information contracts, never silently equated.
forbidden: using total current alone as solver interface
global shared hidden state across distinct compartments

baselines.role: primary causal accuracy reference and competitive optimized cost baseline
strong numerical cost/quality baseline, not learned
historical reference, all seeds; original success under its own thresholds, not universal success under tighter IE criteria
frozen learned coefficient maps with explicit state; not a recurrent latent model or dense MLP speedup

hypotheses.statement: Learning a joint discrete state transition can remove useful work beyond separately learned rates while preserving 18 physical states.
hypotheses.contrast: Task38 joint transition versus frozen discrete-coefficient map and exact formula, same state and readout
hypotheses.falsifier: No admissible quality/cost point in registered capacity/data/budget range; scoped, not universal impossibility

hypotheses.statement: Some rare-regime failures can reflect missing independent histories rather than inadequate abstraction.
hypotheses.contrast: new independent rare trajectories versus repetitions, matched exposure budget
hypotheses.falsifier: No held-out regime improvement with added diversity under registered budget; alternative optimization and state explanations remain

hypotheses.statement: Some rare-regime failures can reflect insufficient training exposure or loss imbalance.
hypotheses.contrast: coverage x update budget, plus targeted sampling/loss only when justified; same independent test
hypotheses.falsifier: Saturated or worsening per-regime curves; more compute is not assumed to solve an information collision

hypotheses.statement: Memory compression may preserve the histories needed for future individual currents and recovery.
hypotheses.contrast: same present V with distinct histories, reset/permutation and rollout probes; state dimension separate from network width
hypotheses.falsifier: Indistinguishable latent histories require different futures or persistent intervention/recovery failure in registered domain

hypotheses.statement: Exact cheap conductance/reversal algebra can aid causal generalization more than direct current prediction.
hypotheses.contrast: same recurrence with effective-opening versus direct-current compatible readout
hypotheses.falsifier: Direct readout matches intervention quality and improves cost on disjoint confirmation; no universal necessity claimed

hypotheses.statement: Local ionic abstraction can transfer to genuinely coupled compartments without additional nonlocal hidden inputs.
hypotheses.contrast: frozen local model, disconnected control and true axial coupling on matched geometries
hypotheses.falsifier: Local validity fails under verified coupling; separate coverage from state/interface inadequacy

hypotheses.statement: Stratified causal and autoregressive evaluation detects failures concealed by low aggregate error.
hypotheses.contrast: known defective controls and near-transition/rapid/recovery suites versus ordinary mean-only evaluation
hypotheses.falsifier: Evaluator fails to detect registered defective controls or lacks enough teacher events; suite is then not decision-ready

evaluation_requirements.metric: Per-channel RMSE and maximum absolute error of signed current, plus conditional normalized errors
evaluation_requirements.aggregation: Per regime/channel/trajectory; median, tails, worst-case and support, not only pooled mean

evaluation_requirements.metric: Signed and absolute integrated current error over event and recovery windows
evaluation_requirements.aggregation: Per channel and window; retain cancellation diagnostics

evaluation_requirements.metric: Current peak magnitude/timing, onset/offset, inactivation and paired-pulse recovery
evaluation_requirements.aggregation: Event matching in physical ms, false/missed events retained

evaluation_requirements.metric: Error in teacher-versus-surrogate response difference under same causal intervention
Shift of observed regime-transition threshold, hysteresis and attained regime
evaluation_requirements.aggregation: Teacher convergence/sensitivity first; distinguish dynamic bifurcation from morphology

evaluation_requirements.metric: Error/drift by horizon and first passage beyond tolerance, recovery and burst structure
evaluation_requirements.unit: mV, mM, ms, counts as separate metrics
evaluation_requirements.aggregation: Autonomous rollout without resets; per trajectory/seed, censor nonfailure explicitly

evaluation_requirements.metric: Fixed checklist on aligned traces, phase plots and stimulus-response maps
evaluation_requirements.aggregation: Typical, random, rare and worst cases selected reproducibly; numerical gates still required

evaluation_requirements.metric: Paired wall/CUDA latency, throughput, state/weight/temp bytes and initialization cost
evaluation_requirements.aggregation: Ionic-only, resident full core and operational workload distinct; paired uncertainty and worst-case

task37_required_before_training: frozen numerical current/charge/event/behavior thresholds calibrated on development/native floor
primary ionic cost workload and prospective saving target
future_run_gate.historical_gates: Preserve original Task35 and IE thresholds with original scope. IE-P7 has V RMSE<=0.05 mV, max<=0.1 mV, Ca max<=5e-6 mM and noninferiority checks; these are historical reference criteria, not substitutes for new current/behavior gates.
future_run_gate.task36_completion: All declared sources hashed, inventory/phases verified against code, IE-P7 closed with scoped audit, hypotheses/evaluation specifications and next actions linked in SQLite, integrity verified and snapshots packed. No claim of Task37 readiness or new model performance.
